narration:1:1620775401:1.text: After the restriction spell was cast, the students who had been reluctant to leave the party gradually began to disperse.

say:2:1620775402:1.text: Although I see that there are some regrets, at least this matter has finally come to a close.
say:2:1620775402:1.source_cn: 虽然有一些遗憾，好在事情终于有了结尾。
say:2:1620775402:1.male: Although I see that there are some regrets, at least this matter has finally come to a close.
say:2:1620775402:1.female: Although I see that there are some regrets, at least this matter has finally come to a close.

say:3:1620775403:1.text: Well, everyone worked very hard today. Let's each get some rest, and we'll meet at Verity Plaza tomorrow to see whether the effects of chaos magic have subsided.
say:3:1620775403:1.source_cn: 今天大家都辛苦了。我们各自回去休息，明天在真理广场见面...

narration:4:1620775404:1.text: After spending the night resting in the library, you arrive at Verity Plaza early the following morning.
narration:4:1620775404:1.male: After spending the night resting in the library, you arrive at Verity Plaza early the following morning.
narration:4:1620775404:1.female: After spending the night resting in the library, you arrive at Verity Plaza early the following morning.
